This is a representation/verification change, not a new prune or a length22 search. Cross-check small domains against the predecessor's raw-product oracle and test rejecting implementation mutants.

Expected deliverable: a scoped opt-in implementation, written equivalence argument and same-input before/after benchmark, or an honest failed-performance handoff. Finish/expiry 2026-10-16 16:41 UTC; final 15 minutes reserved for verification/publication. Other candidates considered: four-flat setup acceleration and scatter-export schema repair; chosen task makes the fresh corrected exclusion cheaper to independently replay. Live PR and recent handoff comments refreshed immediately before this claim; the correction claim is released. No overlap with the active set-cover or F-star tasks.
